messages:
Iris: Heads-up 10-min sync: planning a PLG microexperiment called SeedForge. Aim: test two launch-post funnels + gated minisession. Hypotheses: 1) 'credit-first' converts more signups; 2) 'prompt-first' yields higher activation within 24h. Need routing, credit TTL, and a low-cost canary. @Noah @Rhea

Noah: Love it. Routing idea: tag visits on landing with `flow=credit_first` or `flow=prompt_first`. Only grant credits when `utm_medium=post` && `flow=credit_first`. Credit policy: 30 credits, 7-day TTL, 1 redempt per email. Canary pool=200 credits/day first 2 days.

Rhea: Messaging notes: Launch post copy for credit-first: "Get 30 starter credits + ready-made prompt templates 0min build". Prompt-first post: "Ship a demo prompt in 5 mins 0 starter templates included". I'll write 3 subject lines per flow. Keep CTAs explicit: "Redeem credits" vs "Copy starter prompts". :memo:

Sam: Measurement: define activation as "a completion with >= 1 assistant_token and custom_event 'used_template'" within 24h. Create Amplitude cohorts `seedforge_credit` and `seedforge_prompt`. Dashboard should show: signup->activate, credits_redeemed, avg_tokens_first_week, latency_p95.

Vik: Ops: prewarm strategy: warm a small dedicated pool for the first hour of each webinar mini-session. Scale plan: baseline +15% burst, fallback to q8 quantized model if queue>100. Also set per-account rate limit for the redemption API to 1 req/min to avoid abuse.

OpsBot: infra:warm job scheduled for 2026-05-03T15:30:00Z 026-05-03T16:30:00Z window. Canary budget toggle set: budget_daily=200 credits. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/seedforge (internal). :gear:

Iris: Quick onboarding push: after signup, show a small prompt-template carousel and a one-click "apply template" button that injects code. Example snippet for the landing CTA: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-1-start","prompt":"Translate TODO into code using starter template X","max_tokens":150}'``` Keep that snippet copyable.

Noah: For analytics dedupe, use email_hash + landing_session_id. Also log `experiment_flow` on account creation. We'll run the test for 7 days or until 2k signups. Stopping condition: spend > $500 in credits in first 48h or if activation delta negative vs baseline.

Rhea: I'll draft social copy variants and the microsite hero messaging. Also planning a short benchmark thread: highlight "starter-template to first-completion delta" and a simple table of token costs vs baseline prompts. Numbers-first, then narrative.

Sam: Instrumentation checklist: signup.created -> include utm params, experiment_flow; credit.granted -> credit_id, ttl; template.applied -> template_id; first.successful_completion -> tokens_out, latency_ms. I'll post the spec to analytics channel.

Vik: Ops note: add circuit-breaker to disable credit grants if the redemption service error rate > 3% for 5m. Also add a fallback email with template links in case onboarding push fails.

Iris: Great. Owners: Rhea=copy+landing, Noah=routing+credit-service, Sam=analytics+dashboard, Vik=ops+runbook. Can everyone post final PRs by Thu EOD? Quick review Friday AM. :rocket: 

Noah: Putting the routing rule pseudo: ```if utm_campaign == 'seedforge_launch' and landing.flow == 'credit_first' and account.new==true: grant_credits(30, ttl_days=7, tag='seedforge_credit') else: none```

Sam: + add server-side dedupe by email_hash, and expose `experiment_flow` as a dimension in dashboards.

Rhea: I'll post copy in #content-drafts and ping here. Will include a short testimonial-style line for the benchmark post.

Iris: Perfect. Thanks all. We'll reconvene after drafts. :raised_hands:
